messages:
maria_acme: Heads up — since ~06:25 UTC our Dedicated pool 'eu-prod-reserve' in eu-west is returning 503s and lots of tail latency for redwood-13b-v1. Customers reporting placement_error + some 12s responses. Req ids: req_a12, req_a13.
carla_support: Thanks, investigating. Can you paste a sample curl and the raw response? Also, is this affecting hosted API or only Dedicated? @ben_ops please eyeball infra.
mar ia_acme: sample: ``
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-xxx' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-v1","input":"hi"}'
``
response: 503 {"error":"placement_error","code":"NO_AVAILABLE_DEVICE"} — happening across eu-west pools, a few intermittent 401s too.
ben_ops: Seeing placement failures from placement-controller in eu-west. Autoscaler tried to add nodes 3x and got cloud errors: "Err: QuotaExceeded: GPUs". Placement QPS spiked to ~140/s and route-engine returned 429s. Suspect noisy tenant + quota ceiling. Logs attached.
ryan_sre: Confirm. One reservation (alloc-427) ramped to ~300 concurrent streams, KV cache thrash + local mem pressure, caused GPU eviction cascade. Key logs:
```
2026-03-17T06:25:40Z placement ERROR alloc=alloc-427 reason=GPU_EXHAUSTION msg=NO_AVAILABLE_DEVICE
2026-03-17T06:26:01Z autoscaler WARN attempt=1 err=QuotaExceeded: GPUs request=req_a12
```
deploy-bot: autoscaler attempted scale @06:26UTC -> +4 nodes requested, failed on cloud quota. Canary fallback triggered: route to 'redwood-13b-q4' in eu-west2 and overflow to na-west.
carla_support: We pushed temporary routing rules to divert new traffic to eu-west2 and na-west fallbacks. Maria — can you retry and confirm impact?
maria_acme: After switch, new request errors dropped from ~30% -> ~4%, and p50 latency ~350ms. Existing sessions pinned to old alloc still show high tails due to KV affinity. Also saw token rotate around 06:24 — some 401s causing client retries.
ben_ops: Repro steps for infra: 1) run rps-tester concurrency=250 against redwood-13b-v1 on dedicated endpoint 2) expect placement errors + 429s within 60s 3) collect placement-controller + autoscaler logs 4) check auth log spikes for 401 TTLs. We observed a retry storm tied to token rotations that amplified load.
ryan_sre: Immediate mitigations: - open cloud quota request for eu-west GPUs (ticket created) - apply throttling policy to offending tenant to 20r/s - enable fallback to on-demand shared pool for overflow - add alert: dedicated_pool_gpu_utilization >85% for 2m - create RCA ticket and assign to eng-infra/eng-sre.
carla_support: Incident INC-221234 created and assigned. Notifying account team and billing for reconciliation risk if requests retried and billed. Maria please attach customer logs and token timestamps.
maria_acme: Uploaded logs (401 spikes + req ids). Can you confirm whether 401s originated from our SDK or from your auth layer? We rotated tokens at 06:24.
ben_ops: Initial analysis: three contributing factors — (1) misbehaving tenant client with runaway concurrency, (2) cloud GPU quota blocked autoscaler from replenishing capacity, (3) token rotation edge caused 401s & retries. Fixes: throttle tenant, request quota bump, patch token handling to avoid TTL race.
ryan_sre: Working on a KV hotfix to reduce tails for sessions pinned to dead allocs (evicted GPUs). ETA ~1.5-2h for canary. Also adding a placement backoff to reduce QPS spike to controller.
alice_eng: I'll review the KV migration patch and add regression tests that simulate fallback + pinned KV to avoid long tails next time.
carla_support: Follow-ups: formal postmortem, customer-impact timeline, and scheduling a call with ACME support. Tagging billing and account managers.
maria_acme: Thanks — please include repro steps and timeline in postmortem so we can share with customers.
ryan_sre: TL;DR: noisy tenant + quota cap -> autoscaler blocked -> placement errors + 429s -> routing failover mitigated new requests; pinned sessions still affected. Keeping incident open until quota confirmed and tenant throttled.
carla_support: I'll keep INC-221234 updated with timeline, mitigation actions, and next steps. Closing only after quota increase and KV patch verification. Thanks everyone.
